tradition.lineage: Cádiz Carnival sustains a civic tradition of topical songs, parody and costumed street performance. Neighborhood associations, rehearsals and the official competition connect coros, comparsas, chirigotas and cuartetos, each with its own vocal organization and repertoire. The tango, pasodoble, cuplé and comic sketch give these groups distinct ways to comment on public life.

extras.description: Comic dialogue, topical verses and sung cuplés share the stage in the cuarteto branch, with buzzing carnival pitos providing pitch cues. Cádiz also sustains harmonized comparsas, guitar-and-percussion chirigotas and plucked-string coros, each with its own repertoire and ensemble practice.
